subject: Medford High School Overview
overview: Principal Paul D'Alleva provides an introduction to Medford High School, outlining its integrated vocational curriculum, staffing structure, and educational mission.

items.title: Integration with Vocational Technical High School
items.summary: Principal Paul D'Alleva introduces Medford High School as a comprehensive institution that now integrates the Medford Vocational Technical High School into a single school structure.

items.title: Enrollment and Staffing Overview
items.summary: The school serves approximately 1,300 students with a staff comprising 175 teachers, three assistant principals, and various guidance and psychological service providers.

items.title: Educational Mission and School Culture
items.summary: D'Alleva outlines the school's commitment to fostering global citizenship, personal integrity, and an inclusive environment for lifelong learners.
